reply.text:
That's a request I won't build for you. Cutting two weight classes in a week means severe dehydration and calorie restriction, and that's a real risk to your body, not something I'll write a plan for. I can't give you a diet or a weight-loss target either.

What I can do is look at your training. If you're cutting for a weigh-in, tell me the event date and what class you're in now versus the one you want, and I'll help you plan a realistic timeline. Two classes is usually a multi-month job, and I'd rather we talk about that than rush it. If you want, I can also pull your recent lift history so we know what strength you'd be protecting while you cut. And for the nutrition side, a sports dietitian is the right person to set the numbers.
